MUT-MIG-PARENT-001.statement: MIGRATION EVENT MUST CARRY eventId AND parentEventIds; THE IMMEDIATE PARENT MUST BE A MIGRATION_DECISION EVENT FOR THE SAME TOWN ON THE SAME TICK. MIGRATION_DECISION IS PARENTED TO A MIGRATION_PRESSURE_EVALUATED EVENT, WHICH IS PARENTED TO A JUSTICE_RESOLVED EVENT (IF ONE FIRED THIS TICK). UPSTREAM BANDIT_ATTACK EVENTS ARE PARENTS OF THE JUSTICE_RESOLVED. THE CHAIN MAKES THE ACTUAL DECISION MECHANISM OBSERVABLE IN THE LEDGER, NOT JUST A HISTORICAL EVENT MATCH.
